title: Bicolandia Marathon 2026 Review: Sorsogon's Bicol-Region 42K
meta_description: Bicolandia Marathon 2026: September 27 in Sorsogon City. Full marathon from RYLMNL in the Bicol region.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 in Sorsogon City, this RYLMNL-organised marathon brings a full 42K to the Bicol region.
verdict: The Bicolandia Marathon is a RYLMNL-organised full marathon in Sorsogon City — the capital of Sorsogon province in the Bicol region, at Luzon's southern tip. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). Sorsogon is known for whale-shark interactions in Donsol, the Bulusan Volcano, and a wild coastline. September is the tail of the typhoon season in Bicol. A regional Philippine marathon with genuine destination appeal.

sections.heading: Bicol: Luzon's Southern Tip
paragraphs: Sorsogon province sits at Luzon's southernmost point, known for whale sharks, volcanoes, and dramatic coastline. [1] RYLMNL is a named regional organiser. September conditions in Bicol are warm and potentially wet.
